summary: A classic daily with real debate: Endgame, Avatar and Titanic are gimmes, Ne Zha 2 and the new Spider-Man are the surprises, and Jurassic World, The Lion King and Barbie are painful near misses. Even better as a Blitz. Ran as a daily on 2026-10-24.
reasons: The casual player found 6 before running out of lives, all on famous films just outside the top 10, which feels like a lesson rather than a trick.
Very current top 10 (Spider-Man: Brand New Day #3, Zootopia 2 #10, The Odyssey #11) keeps it fresh but will date quickly.
Blitz is deep: nearly every big blockbuster a casual player names scores.
fixes: Remove wrong sequel aliases: 'Spider-Man 3' on #9 No Way Home (a different 2007 film; it currently gives free credit), 'Avatar IV' on #4, 'Zootopia Three' on #10, 'Top Gun 3' and 'Untitled third Top Gun film' on #17, 'Star Wars 10' on #45, 'Inside Out 3' on #12, 'The Lion King 4' on #14, 'Frozen IIII' on #19.
Add 'Avatar 3' to #18 Avatar: Fire and Ash (currently not recognized).
Drop Titanic home-video aliases ('Titanic DVD releases', 'Titanic VHS', 'Titanic 5 Disc', etc.) and 'Frozen fandom'.
'spiderman' offers Spider-Man 2 / Brand New Day / Far From Home but not #9 No Way Home; the choice list should include it.
